newsitem.title: USA: NYSE Nov 11-15 program trading averages 11.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: NYSE Nov 11-15 program trading averages 11.1 pct.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange on Thursday said program trading amounted to 11.1 percent of its average daily volume of 453.0 million shares, or 50.4 million shares a day for the week of November 11-15.
For the prior week, program trading was 11.2 percent of its average daily volume of 460.8 million shares, or 51.4 million shares a day.
Of the average 50.4 million shares a day during the latest week, buy programs accounted for 6.7 percent and sell programs accounted for 4.4 percent.
